payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerate all partitions of 7 heroes into 3 teams of given sizes by iterating over combinations for two teams and deducing the third. Compute total liking from directed edges within teams.
payload.rationale: The solution uses itertools.combinations to try all possible team assignments, which is a complete search over subsets, not permutations. Among candidates, search_bitmask_enumeration (subset enumeration) is the best fit.
